will (ml): Heads-up: bringing up zephra13b int4 — intermittent OOMs on long convo workloads. reproduces after ~9k session tokens.
tara (infra): Any quick repro config? microbatch size, prefetch mode?
will (ml): Repro snippet: ```model=zephra13b
quant=int4
batch_size=5
max_new_tokens=1200
prefetch=aggressive
```
sam (runtime): That combination is high-risk: int4 reduces footprint but increases KV allocation churn. Aggressive prefetch + deep KV history -> freelist fragmentation.
ivy (prodex): Can we run a short canary with conservative defaults and collect quality metrics? Prefer not to change user UX without data.
will (ml): Kicked canary: prefetch=lazy, batch=3, max_new_tokens=600, kv_eviction_threshold=0.72, reserve_ratio=0.04. Tag: canary/zephra13b/2026-03-27-a.
deploy-bot: rolled out canary -> nodes gpu-701,gpu-703 (tag: canary/zephra13b/2026-03-27-a).
tara (infra): Added freelist_fragmentation_pct & slab_free_runaway to canary dashboards. Alert threshold at 12%.
sam (runtime): Also enabled kv_prefetch_lazy=true, compactor.qos=low (interval=45s) and prefetch.skip_threshold=3500.
will (ml): Quick 45m snapshot: baseline before canary p95=430ms, rss_peak=23.9GB, failure_rate=1.1% (OOM+alloc). Canary: failure_rate=0.12%, p95 +28ms, rss -420MB. freelist_fragmentation_pct dropped 19%->5%.
ivy (prodex): What's the QA impact int4-only vs int8-fallback? Need EM numbers.
will (ml): A/B on our convo QA subset: int4-only -0.9% EM. With auto-fallback to int8 for sessions >18k tokens EM gap narrows to -0.18%.
sam (runtime): Recommendation: adopt hosted defaults for zephra13b/int4 -> prefetch=lazy, default_batch=3, max_new_tokens=600, kv_eviction_threshold=0.75, kv_prefetch_lazy=true, reserve_ratio=0.04, compactor.qos=low interval=45s. Auto-fallback to int8 when session_tokens>18k. Also implement session-level prefetch backoff if eviction_count>3 in 5m.
tara (infra): Will gate default change behind feature-flag and run 24h canary. Add kernel_colocation probe to detect heavy-kernel hotspots. If kernel_colocation_score>0.7, isolate heavyweight kernels.
ivy (prodex): I'll draft console blurb: "zephra13b int4 defaults optimized for long-convo stability; contact support for Dedicated capacity if you need >1k tokens." Include rollback triggers: EM delta >1% or unexplained OOMs.
will (ml): ML action: upload full eval CSV after 24h; regression check threshold 1%. If >1% revert to int8-fallback default.
deploy-bot: canary update: 0 OOMs in last 90m on canary hosts.
sam (runtime): Small follow-up: consider a lightweight per-session compaction hint when session predicted tail >6k to prioritize compaction.
tara (infra): Added compaction_hint metric to canary telemetry.
will (ml): TL;DR: root cause isolated (aggressive prefetch + int4 + long KV chains). Canary mitigations (lazy prefetch, lower max_new_tokens, small reserve, compactor, int8 auto-fallback) look effective. Will post final CSV and decide default flip after 24h. :thumbsup:
